extracted.intended_audience: Heads of executive departments and establishments; department/agency directors responsible for management, planning, budgeting, personnel, logistics, communications, security, training, finance, medical services, and related administrative functions
extracted.subtask_description: Transmittal memorandum rescinding the requirement for submission of an Annual Management Report under OMB Circular No. A-44 (Revised), and preserving remaining policy aspects of the Management Improvement Program while new guidance is prepared.

rubrics_metrics.name: Requirement for Annual Management Report (rescinded)
rubrics_metrics.description: The requirement for the submission of an Annual Management Report, as prescribed by the Office of Management and Budget Circular No. A-44, Revised, dated May 24, 1972, is rescinded.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Effective immediately; applies to all departments and agencies. Agencies no longer must prepare or submit the Annual Management Report specified by the cited Circular.

rubrics_metrics.name: Policy aspects of the Management Improvement Program remain in effect
rubrics_metrics.description: The remaining portions of the Circular dealing with policy aspects of the Management Improvement Program remain in effect.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Although the Annual Management Report requirement is rescinded, departments and agencies must continue to comply with the policy provisions of the Circular until revised guidance is issued. The program is under review and new policy guidelines will be forthcoming.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applicability and effective date of the transmittal
rubrics_metrics.description: This transmittal memorandum applies to all departments and agencies and is effective immediately.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Directed to the heads of executive departments and establishments; recipients should treat the rescission as immediately binding for their agencies’ administrative practices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Official routing slip actions (document routing categories)
rubrics_metrics.description: Routing slip labels listed for internal document handling: ACTION, APPROVAL, COMMENT, CONCURRENCE, DIRECT REPLY, INFORMATION, PREPARE REPLY, RECOMMENDATION, RETURN, SIGNATURE.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These are the standard action/handling categories for routing internal documents; the routing slip instructs users to 'Use previous editions.'
